format: html

Select a country from the dropdown below to display its flag.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)

# Read all .png filenames from the w2560 folder
flag_codes <- sub("\\.png$", "", list.files("w2560", pattern = "\\.png$"))

# Load the UCI Flag dataset for colors, patterns, and symbols
uci <- read.csv(
  "https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/machine-learning-databases/flags/flag.data",
  header = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    code = case_match(
      V1,
      "Comorro-Islands" ~ "km",
      "Czechoslovakia" ~ "cz",
      "Micronesia" ~ "fm",
      "North-Yemen" ~ "ye",
      "Parguay" ~ "py",
      "Soloman-Islands" ~ "sb",
      "Turks-Cocos-Islands" ~ "tc",
      "US-Virgin-Isles" ~ "vi",
      .default = tolower(countrycode::countrycode(
        gsub("-", " ", V1), "country.name", "iso2c", warn = FALSE
      ))
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(code), code %in% flag_codes) |>
  distinct(code, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Fallback attributes for post-1990 countries and territories not in the 1990 UCI dataset
extra_flags <- tribble(
  ~code, ~extra_colors, ~extra_pattern, ~extra_symbols,
  "am", "red, blue, orange", "Horizontal stripes", "None",
  "aq", "blue, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Triangle, Emblem / Crest",
  "aw", "red, blue, gold, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun",
  "ax", "red, blue, gold", "Cross / Saltire", "None",
  "az", "red, green, blue, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun, Crescent",
  "ba", "blue, gold, white", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Triangle",
  "bl", "red, blue, gold, white", "Solid / Centered", "Emblem / Crest",
  "bq", "red, blue, gold, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun, Emblem / Crest",
  "bv", "red, blue, white", "Cross / Saltire", "None",
  "by", "red, green, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Emblem / Crest",
  "cc", "green, gold", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Crescent, Circle",
  "cw", "blue, gold, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun",
  "cx", "green, blue, gold, white", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Circle, Emblem / Crest",
  "ee", "blue, black, white", "Horizontal stripes", "None",
  "eh", "red, green, white, black", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun, Crescent, Triangle",
  "er", "red, green, blue, gold", "Solid / Centered", "Triangle, Emblem / Crest",
  "gb-eng", "red, white", "Cross / Saltire", "None",
  "gb-nir", "red, white, gold", "Cross / Saltire", "Stars / Sun, Emblem / Crest",
  "gb-sct", "blue, white", "Cross / Saltire", "None",
  "gb-wls", "red, green, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Emblem / Crest",
  "ge", "red, white", "Cross / Saltire", "None",
  "gg", "red, gold, white", "Cross / Saltire", "None",
  "gp", "red, blue, white", "Vertical bars", "None",
  "gs", "red, blue, gold, white", "Canton / Quartered", "Emblem / Crest",
  "hm", "red, blue, white", "Canton / Quartered", "Stars / Sun",
  "hr", "red, blue, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Emblem / Crest",
  "im", "red, white, gold", "Solid / Centered", "Emblem / Crest",
  "io", "red, blue, gold, white", "Canton / Quartered", "Emblem / Crest",
  "je", "red, gold, white", "Cross / Saltire", "Emblem / Crest",
  "kg", "red, gold", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Circle",
  "kz", "blue, gold", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Emblem / Crest",
  "lt", "red, green, gold", "Horizontal stripes", "None",
  "lv", "red, white", "Horizontal stripes", "None",
  "md", "red, blue, gold", "Vertical bars", "Emblem / Crest",
  "me", "red, gold", "Solid / Centered", "Emblem / Crest",
  "mf", "red, blue, white", "Vertical bars", "None",
  "mh", "blue, orange, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun",
  "mk", "red, gold", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Circle",
  "mo", "green, gold, white", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Emblem / Crest",
  "mq", "red, green, black", "Horizontal stripes", "Triangle",
  "na", "red, green, blue, gold, white", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Triangle",
  "nc", "red, green, blue, gold, black", "Horizontal stripes", "Circle, Emblem / Crest",
  "nf", "green, white", "Vertical bars", "Emblem / Crest",
  "pm", "red, blue, white", "Vertical bars", "None",
  "pn", "red, green, blue, gold, white", "Canton / Quartered", "Emblem / Crest",
  "ps", "red, green, white, black", "Horizontal stripes", "Triangle",
  "pw", "blue, gold", "Solid / Centered", "Circle",
  "re", "red, blue, white", "Vertical bars", "None",
  "rs", "red, blue, white, gold", "Horizontal stripes", "Emblem / Crest",
  "si", "red, blue, white, gold", "Horizontal stripes", "Emblem / Crest",
  "sj", "red, blue, white", "Cross / Saltire", "None",
  "sk", "red, blue, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Cross / Saltire, Emblem / Crest",
  "ss", "red, green, blue, gold, white, black", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun, Triangle",
  "sx", "red, blue, gold, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Triangle, Emblem / Crest",
  "tf", "red, blue, white", "Canton / Quartered", "Stars / Sun, Text",
  "tj", "red, green, gold, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun, Emblem / Crest",
  "tk", "blue, gold, white", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Triangle",
  "tl", "red, gold, white, black", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Triangle",
  "tm", "red, green, gold, white", "Vertical bars", "Stars / Sun, Crescent",
  "ua", "blue, gold", "Horizontal stripes", "None",
  "um", "red, blue, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun",
  "uz", "red, green, blue, white", "Horizontal stripes", "Stars / Sun, Crescent",
  "wf", "red, blue, white", "Canton / Quartered", "Triangle",
  "xk", "blue, gold, white", "Solid / Centered", "Stars / Sun, Emblem / Crest",
  "yt", "red, blue, white", "Vertical bars", "None"
)

# Build a clean summary table of colors, pattern, and symbols for each flag
flag_features <- tibble(code = flag_codes) |>
  left_join(uci, by = "code") |>
  left_join(extra_flags, by = "code") |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    colors = ifelse(
      !is.na(V18),
      paste(
        c("red", "green", "blue", "gold", "white", "black", "orange")[
          c(V11, V12, V13, V14, V15, V16, V17) == 1
        ],
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      extra_colors
    ),
    pattern = case_when(
      !is.na(V8) & (V20 > 0 | V21 > 0) ~ "Cross / Saltire",
      !is.na(V8) & V22 > 0 ~ "Canton / Quartered",
      !is.na(V8) & V8 > 0 ~ "Vertical bars",
      !is.na(V8) & V9 > 0 ~ "Horizontal stripes",
      !is.na(V8) ~ "Solid / Centered",
      TRUE ~ extra_pattern
    ),
    symbols = ifelse(
      !is.na(V19),
      {
        syms <- c(
          if (V23 > 0) "Stars / Sun",
          if (V24 > 0) "Crescent",
          if (V19 > 0) "Circle",
          if (V25 > 0) "Triangle",
          if (V26 > 0 || V27 > 0) "Emblem / Crest",
          if (V28 > 0) "Text"
        )
        if (length(syms) == 0) "None" else paste(syms, collapse = ", ")
      },
      extra_symbols
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(code, colors, pattern, symbols)

ojs_define(flag_codes = flag_codes, flag_features = flag_features)
```

```{ojs}
regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(["en"], { type: "region" })

ukNations = ({
  "gb-eng": "England",
  "gb-nir": "Northern Ireland",
  "gb-sct": "Scotland",
  "gb-wls": "Wales"
})

// Combine country names with their flag features
countries = transpose(flag_features)
  .map(d => ({
    ...d,
    name: ukNations[d.code] ?? regionNames.of(d.code.toUpperCase())
  }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))

// Create an interactive dropdown menu; `viewof` exposes the selected value
viewof selected = Inputs.select(countries, {
  label: "Choose a country:",
  format: d => d.name
})

// Helper to compute overlap between comma-separated feature strings
overlapScore = (a, b) => {
  const setA = a.split(", ")
  const setB = b.split(", ")
  const shared = setA.filter(x => setB.includes(x)).length
  if (shared === 0) return 0
  return a === b ? 100 : shared / Math.max(setA.length, setB.length)
}

// Find other flags sharing the same or most similar colors, pattern, and symbols
similarColor = countries
  .filter(d => d.code !== selected.code)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, score: overlapScore(selected.colors, d.colors) }))
  .filter(d => d.score >= 0.5)
  .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
  .slice(0, 8)

similarPattern = countries
  .filter(d => d.code !== selected.code && d.pattern === selected.pattern)
  .slice(0, 8)

similarSymbols = countries
  .filter(d => d.code !== selected.code)
  .map(d => ({ ...d, score: overlapScore(selected.symbols, d.symbols) }))
  .filter(d => d.score > 0)
  .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
  .slice(0, 8)

// Helper to render a list of matching country names
formatMatches = list => list.length > 0 ? list.map(d => d.name).join(", ") : "None found in dataset"

// Helper to render flag thumbnail images for a list of countries
renderFlagGrid = list => list.length > 0
  ? html`<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
      ${list.map(d => html`<div style="text-align: center; width: 110px;">
        <img 
          src="w2560/${d.code}.png" 
          alt="Flag of ${d.name}" 
          style="width: 100px; height: 66px; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px;"
        />
        <div style="font-size: 0.8rem; margin-top: 0.25rem;">${d.name}</div>
      </div>`)}
    </div>`
  : html`<p style="color: #6c757d; font-size: 0.9rem;">None found in dataset</p>`

// Display the local flag image, the similarity info box, and the similar flag images underneath
html`<div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
  <h3>${selected.name}</h3>
  <img 
    src="w2560/${selected.code}.png" 
    alt="Flag of ${selected.name}" 
    style="width: 320px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px;"
  />

  <div style="margin-top: 1.25rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; background: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 8px; max-width: 600px;">
    <h4 style="margin-top: 0;">Flag Features & Similar Flags</h4>
    <p>
      <strong>Colors (${selected.colors}):</strong><br/>
      Similar: ${formatMatches(similarColor)}
    </p>
    <p>
      <strong>Pattern (${selected.pattern}):</strong><br/>
      Similar: ${formatMatches(similarPattern)}
    </p>
    <p style="margin-bottom: 0;">
      <strong>Symbols (${selected.symbols}):</strong><br/>
      Similar: ${formatMatches(similarSymbols)}
    </p>
  </div>

  <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
    <h5>Similar by Color</h5>
    ${renderFlagGrid(similarColor)}

    <h5>Similar by Pattern</h5>
    ${renderFlagGrid(similarPattern)}

    <h5>Similar by Symbols</h5>
    ${renderFlagGrid(similarSymbols)}
  </div>
</div>`
```
